name: Croaky's Head

angles.text: As an Alliance champion, you aid Stormwind's overextended forces by eliminating dangerous leaders who prey on travelers. Securing the eastern border road reinforces Alliance authority between Elwynn and Redridge.

As a human of Elwynn, you face murloc incursions that threaten homesteads and claim the lives of local town guardsmen. Slaying Croaky brings justice for two fallen watchmen and defends the realm's heartland.
As a warrior, you know the brutal reality of frontline combat and the cost paid by fallen watchmen. Felling an aggressive chieftain relieves a hard-pressed defensive line.

aliases: what kind of murloc is croaky
faq.answer: Croaky was a notorious murloc leader who terrorized travelers and patrols along eastern Elwynn Forest's waterways. His particularly aggressive ambushes near roads threatened regional peace until an adventurer hunted him down.

Merell Ross is a member of the Stormwind city watch stationed at Ridgepoint Tower on Elwynn Forest's eastern border. Ross oversees border security and seeks to rally the garrison after murloc raids killed guards. The watch protects the high road into the Redridge Mountains.

Ridgepoint Tower guards the far eastern edge of Elwynn Forest and the road into the Redridge Mountains. East of the Eastvale Logging Camp, the stone garrison houses Stormwind guards facing hostile creatures and highway bandits.

aliases: why do guards want croakys head
faq.answer: Murlocs recently killed two Ridgepoint Tower patrol members in the surrounding woods and waters. The guards want Croaky dead to stop the road ambushes and begin a concerted effort to drive the murlocs out of Elwynn.
faq.q: Why did the guards at Ridgepoint Tower want Croaky dead?

aliases: what happens when you kill croaky
faq.answer: Bringing Croaky's Head to Ridgepoint Tower proves a dangerous organizer of roadside raids is dead. The guards hope to regain the offensive, secure eastern trade paths, and gradually push murloc tribes from Elwynn's riverbanks.
faq.q: What does turning in Croaky's Head accomplish for Elwynn Forest?

faq.answer: Murlocs commonly nest along Elwynn Forest's rivers, lakes, and streams, and key roads run beside those waterways. Their tribes ambush travelers, trade caravans, and isolated patrols, overwhelming defenders with unpredictable numbers and fierce raids.
faq.q: Why are murlocs such a threat along Elwynn's roads?

sections.body: Murlocs along Elwynn Forest's rivers and streams have grown bolder. They ambush travelers and threaten trade routes. Croaky was a particularly aggressive chieftain who rallied other murlocs to attack near local roads. Merchants, farmers, and travelers between Elwynn and Redridge now face deadly roads. Croaky's death ends his ambushes and removes a threat to Stormwind's hold on the eastern woodland outskirts.
sections.title: Terror on the Eastvale Roads

sections.body:
Ridgepoint Tower guards Elwynn Forest's eastern edge and the strategic crossing into the Redridge Mountains. Officer Merell Ross leads the guards, though dangers around the outpost have stretched them thin. Murloc attacks recently killed two watchmen on patrol.

The deaths shook the garrison and exposed the vulnerable border. Bringing Croaky's severed head to Ross proves the chieftain is dead. Now the guards have reason to hope they can drive the raiders back from Elwynn's borders.
sections.title: The Watch at Ridgepoint Tower

summary: At Ridgepoint Tower, Croaky's death brings grim relief to a grieving Stormwind garrison. The murloc leader terrorized eastern Elwynn's roads. Proof of his death gives the guards hope as they struggle to secure the waterways.
